title: Go-TOPS tool lock
description: go-tops.lock (section 10): the Go toolchain and the downloaded binaries, each pinned by an exact version and a SHA-256 per platform. Module tools are pinned in tools/go.mod, not here. The file is YAML.

toolchain.description: The exact Go release the gate runs on; go env GOVERSION must equal it (section 2).

trust.description: How the SHA-256 values were obtained (section 10).

mode.description: checksum: each value was copied from the upstream release checksum file. tofu: trust on first use, because the upstream release is mutable or unsigned.

note.description: Where the values came from, or why trust on first use was needed.

binaries.description: At least one binary: a lock with no binary pins nothing.

version.description: The exact release, with no leading v; the url template spells the tag.

url.description: An https URL template. The only placeholders are {version}, {os} and {arch}.

extract.description: Where the executable sits inside the downloaded archive, as a template with the same placeholders. Absent when the download is the executable.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the downloaded file (the archive when there is an extract path), one per platform. All four are required.

executable_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the executable inside the archive, one per platform. Required with extract, and absent without it: the gate and lock --verify compare the installed executable with this hash.
